k19m.motion:
High on the steel beam, the seven sit in a row, the small woman in the canary-yellow coat in the middle with space either side of her. On each beat she swings her crossed ankles and jabs a gloved finger at the lens, head tilted, while the man in the pinstripe suit hands his sandwich with a banknote poking out to the man in the cream suit, who gives it a slow, approving look. The others sit calmly, legs swinging gently over the drop. She moves with swagger and attitude the whole time: chin up, hips leading, a loose bratty shoulder roll on the beat, never stiff. Locked-off camera, framing holds, all seven stay seated, masks and suits unchanged. SFX: wind at height, distant riveting, far-off city hum.

Thanks.

a01m.motion:
Locked-off camera, framing holds. The seven masked figures walk slowly toward the camera in step, an unhurried stride, guns resting upright on their shoulders, the small woman in the canary-yellow coat half a step ahead in the middle, her gun pointing at the sky like theirs. She moves with swagger and attitude the whole time: chin up, hips leading, a loose bratty shoulder roll on the beat, never stiff. Their heads nod gently with each step. Long shadows slide forward over the cobbles. Every parked car stays parked and unchanged; the street stays empty behind them. Masks, gloves and clothes stay exactly as they are. SFX: shoes on cobbles in a steady rhythm. Ambient noise: a quiet early-morning street.

Thanks.

k04m.motion:
From the first frame the seven keep walking straight at the lens in their line, one stride per beat, open overcoats flaring behind them, the small woman in the canary-yellow coat in the middle, hands in her coat pockets, coat swinging. She moves with swagger and attitude the whole time: chin up, hips leading, a loose bratty shoulder roll on the beat, never stiff. The grey-masked man tugs his cuff straight once; the man on the far right glances down at his pocket watch, then snaps it shut. Nobody turns his head. The marquee bulbs keep chasing; rain glints on the cobbles. Long-lens compression, so they grow only slightly larger. Locked-off camera, framing holds; masks, clothes and gloves unchanged. SFX: heavy footsteps on wet stone, light rain, a faint electric hum. No speech, no music.

Thanks.

h06.motion:
Locked-off camera, framing holds. From the first half-second all seven bounce together on the beat, knees flexing. On the first beat the small woman in the canary-yellow coat, in the middle, jabs her finger at the lens while the men snap gloved right hands up from the low chop and chop down again. Next beat PLUM and MARINE swing open palms toward us. Then RUST and SILVER pump fists at the lens and BOTTLE rocks his free hand, the lunch pail kept low, while she jabs again and shrugs. She moves with swagger and attitude the whole time: chin up, hips leading, a loose bratty shoulder roll on the beat, never stiff. They keep trading moves in their places. Seven figures throughout; masks, triangles, gloves, clothes and city unchanged. SFX: boot stamps on planks, cloth, wind, no voices.

Thanks.

h01.motion:

First beat: the small woman in the canary-yellow coat, in the middle, jabs her finger at the lens twice. Next: PLUM and BOTTLE chop gloved palms down in unison. Next: MARINE and RUST pump their fists either side of her. Next: SILVER spreads both arms wide, palms down. Then all seven chop down together and she jabs again. She moves with swagger and attitude the whole time: chin up, hips leading, a loose bratty shoulder roll on the beat, never stiff. Everyone stays in their place. Masks, clothes, gloves and hats stay unchanged; the customers keep their hands up. SFX: stamping shoes on marble, cloth swishing, a quiet lobby echo.

Thanks.

c03g.motion:
Locked-off camera, no camera movement. The seven round the iron press perform together like a stadium act in a cellar, the small woman in the canary-yellow coat in front in the middle. On the first beat all seven punch their fists up at the low ceiling in unison. On the next they bounce at the knees, shoulders shrugging, heads nodding hard. Then she slams both gloves flat on top of the press while the men point down at it with both hands, mock-outraged. Then all seven throw both arms up, palms raised, and pump them on every beat. She moves with swagger and attitude the whole time: chin up, hips leading, a loose bratty shoulder roll on the beat, never stiff. Nobody leaves their place. Stamps and cloth rustle.

Thanks.

k01m.motion:

Thanks.

h02.motion:

CRIMSON nods deep on every downbeat. MARINE swings his arm up late and points; SILVER shrugs, palms up, then chops again. She moves with swagger and attitude the whole time: chin up, hips leading, a loose bratty shoulder roll on the beat, never stiff. They never stop: a new move every beat, bouncing in their places. Thanks.

h19.motion:

Thanks.

k36m.motion:
From the first frame the bright spark races along the fuse across the sunburst floor toward the black safe, scattering small sparks that drop and die out. The six crouching men stay crouched in their arc, puffing their cigars, smoke curling upward; nobody hurries. the small woman in the canary-yellow coat, crouched in the middle, points at the cake, then at the lens, then gives a slow, smug shrug. She moves with swagger and attitude the whole time: chin up, hips leading, a loose bratty shoulder roll on the beat, never stiff. The cake on the safe stays still. Thanks.

h07.motion:

Thanks.

h17.motion:

h13.motion:

h18.motion:

h15.motion:

h11.motion:

h12.motion:

p05.motion:

Behind him the small woman in the canary-yellow coat hops on one foot on the girder, jabs her finger at the lens, and lands with a shrug, while the standing men nod together on each beat; the seated man holds his sandwich still. She moves with swagger and attitude the whole time: chin up, hips leading, a loose bratty shoulder roll on the beat, never stiff. Everyone stays on the girder. Thanks.

q12.motion:
Locked-off camera, framing holds. From the first half-second all seven wag their raised index fingers side to side in unison, on the beat, the fingers staying beside their heads, clear of the masks, the small woman in the canary-yellow coat in the middle wagging hers the hardest. On the fourth beat they all stop together, snap the finger down to point at the lens, then give one slow, sarcastic head shake, hers the most exaggerated. She moves with swagger and attitude the whole time: chin up, hips leading, a loose bratty shoulder roll on the beat, never stiff. Feet stay planted; masks, hats and clothes stay exactly as they are. Thanks.

q01.motion:

She moves with swagger and attitude the whole time: chin up, hips leading, a loose bratty shoulder roll on the beat, never stiff. Her mask and coat stay exactly as they are. The man behind keeps to his business, back turned. SFX: glove thumps, cloth rustle, pigeons cooing, distant city.

Thanks.

q04.motion:

Thanks.

q05.motion:

d06m.motion:

g08y.motion:

v11x.motion:
